name: p4lenslite
description: Display P4 blame information inline in VS Code

p4LensLite.enableSymbolCodeLens.markdownDescription: Enable class and function collaborator CodeLens when a document symbol provider is available. If disabled, regular annotate decoration and hover remain enabled.

p4LensLite.openStatePollIntervalSeconds.markdownDescription: Interval in seconds for automatic P4 cache staleness checks based on `p4 opened`. Default is `10`. Set to `0` to disable automatic polling. You can still run **P4LensLite: Check P4 Cache Staleness** manually from the Command Palette.

p4LensLite.descriptionTrace.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable recursive changelist tracing from description payloads. When enabled, hover can follow source changelists declared in the changelist description.

p4LensLite.descriptionTrace.marker.markdownDescription: Marker used to locate the trace payload inside a changelist description. Everything after the last marker occurrence is treated as the payload.

p4LensLite.descriptionTrace.parser.markdownDescription: Parser used for the description trace payload. The first version supports `json` only.

p4LensLite.descriptionTrace.changeKey.markdownDescription: Key used to read the traced changelist number from the parsed description payload.

p4LensLite.descriptionTrace.userKey.markdownDescription: Optional key used to read the traced user from the parsed description payload.

p4LensLite.descriptionTrace.descriptionK.markdownDescription: Optional key used to read the traced description from the parsed description payload.

p4LensLite.descriptionTrace.streamKey.markdownDescription: Optional key used to read the traced stream from the parsed description payload.

p4LensLite.descriptionTrace.maxDepth.markdownDescription: Maximum recursion depth when following traced changelists from description payloads.
